visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair and a floral dress sits in front of a grand piano in a bright room. She holds a music book titled 'Marasy' and speaks energetically to the camera with expressive hand gestures. The environment is well-lit with white walls and a warm domestic feel. (2) The scene cuts to the woman wearing a black t-shirt and a black bucket hat. She holds a pink plush monkey toy, looking into the camera with a distressed, comedic facial expression. She points at the book on the piano stand as various colorful graphic overlays and icons appear. (3) A fast-paced montage begins. Initially, the woman poses against a flashing red LED background with a 'Für Elise' graphic. It then transitions to her playing the piano. The camera alternates between a side view of her playing and a top-down view focusing on her fingers moving rapidly across the keys.
